mapper.select: SELECT DATE(create_time) AS date, SUM(total_amount) AS totalAmount, COUNT(id) AS orderCount FROM sales WHERE create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY DATE(create_time) ORDER BY date ASC

SELECT gt.name AS categoryName, SUM(sd.count) AS totalQuantity, SUM(sd.subtotal) AS totalAmount, ROUND(SUM(sd.subtotal) * 100.0 / ( SELECT SUM(subtotal) FROM sales_detail sd2 INNER JOIN sales s2 ON sd2.sales_id = s2.id WHERE s2.create_time >= #{startDate} AND s2.create_time < #{endDate} ), 2) AS ratio FROM sales_detail sd INNER JOIN sales s ON sd.sales_id = s.id INNER JOIN goods g ON sd.goods_id = g.id INNER JOIN goodstype gt ON g.goodsType = gt.id WHERE s.create_time >= #{startDate} AND s.create_time < #{endDate} GROUP BY gt.id, gt.name ORDER BY totalAmount DESC

SELECT DATE(s.create_time) AS date, SUM((sd.price - g.purchase_price) * sd.count) AS grossProfit FROM sales_detail sd INNER JOIN sales s ON sd.sales_id = s.id INNER JOIN goods g ON sd.goods_id = g.id WHERE s.create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY DATE(s.create_time) ORDER BY date ASC

SELECT g.id AS goodsId, g.name AS goodsName, g.count AS currentStock, COALESCE(SUM(sd.count), 0) AS totalSales, CASE WHEN g.count > 0 THEN ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(sd.count), 0) * 100.0 / g.count, 2) ELSE 0 END AS turnoverRate FROM goods g LEFT JOIN sales_detail sd ON g.id = sd.goods_id LEFT JOIN sales s ON sd.sales_id = s.id AND s.create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) GROUP BY g.id, g.name, g.count HAVING totalSales > 0 ORDER BY turnoverRate DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT g.id AS goodsId, g.name AS goodsName, g.count AS currentStock, COALESCE(SUM(sd.count), 0) AS totalSales, CASE WHEN g.count > 0 THEN ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(sd.count), 0) * 100.0 / g.count, 2) ELSE 0 END AS turnoverRate FROM goods g LEFT JOIN sales_detail sd ON g.id = sd.goods_id LEFT JOIN sales s ON sd.sales_id = s.id AND s.create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) GROUP BY g.id, g.name, g.count HAVING totalSales > 0 ORDER BY turnoverRate ASC LIMIT 10

SELECT g.id AS goodsId, g.name AS goodsName, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(sd.count), 0) / 30.0, 2) AS dailyAverageSales, g.count AS currentStock, CEIL(COALESCE(SUM(sd.count), 0) / 30.0 * #{cycleDays}) - g.count AS suggestQuantity FROM goods g LEFT JOIN sales_detail sd ON g.id = sd.goods_id LEFT JOIN sales s ON sd.sales_id = s.id AND s.create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) GROUP BY g.id, g.name, g.count HAVING suggestQuantity > 0 ORDER BY suggestQuantity DESC
SELECT id, name, storage, goodsType, count, min_count, barcode, specs, unit, retail_price, purchase_price, supplier_id, remark FROM goods WHERE count < min_count ORDER BY count ASC
